description: This file contains shell functions related to boot device detection, upgrade procedures, and image validation for embedded systems, specifically in an OpenWRT environment.

methods.name: export_fitblk_bootdev
methods.description: Detects and exports boot device information based on the rootdisk device, setting environment variables accordingly.

methods.name: fit_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs system upgrade depending on the detected boot method, calling appropriate upgrade functions.

methods.name: fit_check_image
methods.description: Validates the image by checking its magic number and signature, returning an error code if invalid.
